start.text: It's contained. The ransomware has stopped, but now we have to see what it left behind.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. The files are still locked, the laptop is still sick, and the doors are still open.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Anything it touched is still broken, or still open to it. We can't let people go back to work yet.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. Start with the laptop, then the files, then the doors.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Yes, from the offline backup. That is why we kept one. But it must be from before the infection, and we have to test it.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Rebuild first, then restore, then check. I don't want Marta to lose her report.
E.name: Joshua
